## Rules

- Existing migration untouched. `sys_attribute_definitions` is append-only
and unique only by `(attribute_id, revision)`; mutable `(entity, key)` ownership lives in
`sys_attribute_key_reservations`, while backfill progress remains separate. Publishing a revision
and replacing its reservation set is one tenant transaction. No cascade. Exactly one current owner
per entity/key. All six conflicts distinct; default reject.
Writes/DDL never consume cache. DB read only after scope connection guard.

## Guidance

Implement schema exactly as §3.1. Source query may select all rows
and choose max revision deterministically in PHP; do not add DB-specific hidden policy.
